list_recent_notices.description: List the notices USGS volcano observatories sent in the last month, newest first, narrowed by observatory, notice type and how many days back. Each comes with the volcanoes it covers and its link; 'Get a notice' reads one in full.
list_recent_notices.name: list_recent_notices

parameters.description: Only notices from this USGS volcano observatory. Leave empty for all six.
parameters.name: observatory

parameters.description: Only notices of any of these types. An activity notification sent with its notice for aviation counts as both. Leave empty for every type.
parameters.name: notice_types

parameters.description: Only notices sent in this many days, up to 31. Leave empty for all 31.
parameters.name: days

notice_identifier.description: The notice's ID, such as 'DOI-USGS-HVO-2026-10-17T19:56:12+00:00'. 'Get a notice' takes it.

notice_type.description: The kind of notice, such as 'Daily Update'. An activity notification sent with its aviation notice is 'VAN/VONA'.

notice_type_code.description: The notice type's code, such as 'DU'. 'VAN/VONA' notices have 'VV'.

notice_url.description: The notice's page on the USGS site.

observatory_code.description: The code of the USGS observatory that watches it, such as 'hvo'. The Observatory fields take it.

observatory_name.description: The observatory's name, such as 'Hawaiian Volcano Observatory'.

sent_at.description: When it was sent, as an ISO 8601 date and time in UTC.

volcanoes.description: The names of the volcanoes or areas the notice covers. Empty for an observatory-wide update.

vona_url.description: The aviation notice's (VONA's) page on the USGS site, when the notice is one; otherwise empty.

list_volcanoes.description: List every volcano of the United States with its location, elevation, threat category and links, narrowed by observatory, threat category, or words in the name or region.
list_volcanoes.name: list_volcanoes

parameters.description: Only volcanoes from this USGS volcano observatory. Leave empty for all six.
parameters.name: observatory

parameters.description: Only volcanoes in any of these categories of the USGS National Volcanic Threat Assessment. Leave empty for all.
parameters.name: threat_levels

parameters.description: Only volcanoes whose name or region contains these words, such as 'Mauna' or 'Oregon'.
parameters.name: name

volcanoes.description: Each volcano, by observatory and name.

icao_position.description: Its position as aviation notices give it, such as 'N1925 W15517'.

observatory_code.description: The code of the USGS observatory that watches it, such as 'hvo'. The Observatory fields take it.

observatory_name.description: The observatory's name, such as 'Hawaiian Volcano Observatory'.

page_url.description: The volcano's notices page on the USGS site.

region.description: Where it is, such as 'Hawaii' or 'Alaska - Aleutians'.

threat_level.description: Its threat category in the USGS National Volcanic Threat Assessment: 'Very High Threat', 'High Threat', 'Moderate Threat', 'Low Threat' or 'Very Low Threat'. Empty when not yet assessed.

volcano_code.description: USGS's code for the volcano, such as 'hi3'. Every field that takes a volcano accepts it.

volcano_number.description: The volcano's Smithsonian volcano number, such as '332010'. Empty for an area such as 'Cascade Range'. Every field that takes a volcano accepts it.

volcano_url.description: The observatory's page about the volcano.

search_notices.description: Search every notice USGS volcano observatories have sent since 2006 by observatory, volcano, notice type, date range and words in the text, newest first, 20 a page. Each comes with its one-line summaries and link.

parameters.name: observatory

parameters.description: Only notices about this volcano or area: pick one, or type its USGS code, Smithsonian volcano number or name.
parameters.name: volcano

parameters.description: Only notices of this type. Leave empty for every type.
parameters.name: notice_type

parameters.description: Only notices sent on or after this day (UTC).
parameters.name: sent_after

parameters.description: Only notices sent on or before this day (UTC).
parameters.name: sent_before

parameters.description: Only notices whose text contains this exact phrase, in any case, such as 'lava fountain'.
parameters.name: text

parameters.description: Which page of 20 results to return, from 1.
parameters.name: page

count.description: How many notices are on this page.

more_available.description: Whether a later page has more matches.

headlines.description: The notice's one-line summaries, one per volcano or area. Empty for an aviation notice (VONA), whose details 'Get an aviation notice' reads.

notice_identifier.description: The notice's ID, such as 'DOI-USGS-HVO-2026-10-17T19:56:12+00:00'. 'Get a notice' takes it.

notice_type.description: The kind of notice, such as 'Daily Update'.

notice_type_code.description: The notice type's code: VAN (activity notification), VV (aviation notice, VONA), SR (status report), IS (information statement), DU, WU, BU or MU (daily, weekly, biweekly or monthly update).

notice_url.description: The notice's page on the USGS site.

observatory_code.description: The code of the USGS observatory that watches it, such as 'hvo'. The Observatory fields take it.

observatory_name.description: The observatory's name, such as 'Hawaiian Volcano Observatory'.

sent_at.description: When it was sent, as an ISO 8601 date and time in UTC.

volcano_codes.description: USGS's codes for the volcanoes the notice covers.

vona_url.description: The aviation notice's (VONA's) page on the USGS site, when the notice is one; otherwise empty.

total.description: How many notices match, on every page.

total_pages.description: How many pages of 20 the matches fill.

description: Follow US volcanoes through the USGS Volcano Hazards Program: see which volcanoes are above normal and every monitored volcano's alert level and aviation color code, look up any US volcano, read and search the notices its observatories send (from daily updates to eruption warnings), and get the aviation notices (VONAs) and CAP alerts. No account or API key required.
